scientific_integrity: The analytical proof and source comparisons are documented; numerical experiments corroborate but do not independently certify the result. The source vertex classification and type-B cone formula are credited.
scientific_limitations: The phase profile assumes positive finite limiting label-to-coordinate ratio.
Only solid angles, not every conic intrinsic volume, are evaluated for the saturated-rank normal cones.
The normal-cone type-B intrinsic-volume formula is established prior work.
Potential equivalent formulations in general Gaussian L-statistic theory remain a bibliographic risk.
title: A third-order Gaussian mean-width transition in partial permutohedra
